claims.claim: Two Israeli soldiers and two Palestinians were killed near Hebron and Netanyahu ordered a very extensive West Bank operation.
claims.episode_span: Two soldiers dead near Hebron, Israel orders a West Bank-wide closure
claims.source_title: Netanyahu orders ‘very extensive’ operation in West Bank after two Israeli soldiers killed
claims.supporting_quote: Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered the army to prepare for a “very extensive” operation in the occupied West Bank after two Israeli soldiers and two Palestinians were killed in an exchange of fire near a checkpoint in Hebron.

claims.claim: The dead soldiers were Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman, 23, and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem, 20.
claims.episode_span: Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman, 23, and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem, 20
claims.source_title: Israel orders West Bank closure after soldiers killed in attack
claims.supporting_quote: The army said two soldiers, Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman, 23, and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem, 20, were killed and three others were lightly wounded during an attack by Palestinian gunmen.

claims.claim: A ceasefire in Oleshky is set for 29 October so aid can enter and civilians can evacuate.
claims.episode_span: with the ceasefire set for October 29
claims.source_title: Melania Trump has helped broker ceasefire in Russian-occupied Ukrainian town, says White House
claims.supporting_quote: A ceasefire is set to come into effect on 29 October.

claims.claim: Ukraine has not officially confirmed the White House ceasefire announcement.
claims.episode_span: Ukraine had not officially confirmed the deal
claims.source_title: US Announces Russia-Ukraine Ceasefire Deal for Civilian Evacuations in Temporarily Occupied Oleshky
claims.supporting_quote: However, Ukraine has not officially confirmed the ceasefire agreement announced by the White House.

claims.claim: Six people were killed and 28 injured at a church funeral in Jordan's Karak governorate.
claims.episode_span: gunmen killed six people and wounded 28 others on Friday
claims.source_title: Six shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
claims.supporting_quote: Six people were killed when gunmen opened fire on a funeral in central Jordan, a government spokesperson has said.

claims.claim: One person was killed and five wounded in Trappes and La Verrière in an attack French authorities are investigating as terrorism.
claims.episode_span: killed one person and wounded five others, three of them seriously
claims.source_title: Deadly shooting near Paris investigated as 'crime of terrorism', minister says
claims.supporting_quote: One person has been killed and five others wounded - three seriously - in a gun attack in a Parisian suburb which authorities are investigating as "terrorism".

claims.claim: France will deploy 70,000 security personnel on Saturday and ban protests in Marseille and Lyon.
claims.episode_span: 70,000 security personnel will be deployed on Saturday
claims.source_title: French authorities tighten restrictions and ban specific protests
claims.supporting_quote: Paris is extending a partial curfew in parts of the city until Monday, while protests are banned altogether in the cities of Marseille and Lyon. 70,000 security personnel will be deployed on Saturday and only union demonstrations will be authorised.

claims.claim: The Louvre and major Paris museums will close Saturday and 70,000 officers will deploy with helicopters, armoured vehicles and water cannons.
claims.episode_span: the Louvre and major Paris museums will close on Saturday
claims.source_title: Louvre and major Paris museums to close on Saturday over concerns about violence during protests
claims.supporting_quote: Some 70,000 police officers and gendarmes would be deployed, along with helicopters, armoured vehicles and water cannons

claims.supporting_quote: Russia and Ukraine swap 270 prisoners each

claims.claim: Finland is the first country to licence a permanent underground nuclear waste repository.
claims.episode_span: Finland is the first country to licence a permanent underground nuclear-waste repository
claims.source_title: Finland nearing opening of world’s first permanent nuclear waste repository
claims.supporting_quote: Facilities are being built in many countries, but Finland is the first to licence its underground storage facility.
